name: com.michaelo.oxgkit.loggingsystem
description: The OxGKit is a system tool kit commonly used in game development based on Unity design (all are independent tools).

samples.description: The bootstrap prefab that initializes loggers on Awake and loads StreamingAssets/loggersconfig.conf. Drop it into the boot scene once and tune per-logger logActive/logLevel/logColor in the inspector.

Demonstrates [LoggerName] logger declaration, Print/PrintInfo/PrintWarning/PrintError/PrintException output, logger override (isOverride), and runtime reconfiguration via ConfigureLogger/SetLoggersConfig.

Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to use the LoggingSystem: [LoggerName] loggers, LoggingLauncher and loggersconfig.conf, LogLevel/LogColor rules, OXGKIT_LOGGER_ON, and HybridCLR logger initialization. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import (see the sample's README).
